heading: Examinations

tree.heading: In general
tree.text: Each Renewable Fuel Capital Investment company that participates in the program established under this part shall be subject to examinations made at the direction of the Investment Division of the Administration in accordance with this section.

tree.heading: Assistance of private sector entities
tree.text: Examinations under this section may be conducted with the assistance of a private sector entity that has both the qualifications and the expertise necessary to conduct such examinations.

children.heading: In general
children.text: The Administrator may assess the cost of examinations under this section, including compensation of the examiners, against the company examined.

children.heading: Payment
children.text: Any company against which the Administrator assesses costs under this paragraph shall pay such costs.

children.heading: Deposit of funds
children.text: Funds collected under this section shall be deposited in the account for salaries and expenses of the Administration.

sourceCredit: (Pub. L. 85–699, title III, § 393, as added Pub. L. 110–140, title XII, § 1207, Dec. 19, 2007, 121 Stat. 1782.)
